findings.issue: Direct capture invoked sealed container getItem before native use; this generated loot and let spectators open containers vanilla otherwise refuses.
findings.fix: Check pending loot before direct/menu slot reads, including both combined halves and entity inventories. Keep supported inspection without item getters.
findings.reproduction: Unchanged alpha92 jars reproduce on both loaders; patched jars retain loot table and spectator menu refusal.

findings.issue: Int overflow in block/item radius distance and JDBC bounds could return false matches or omit nearby history for accepted extreme coordinates.
findings.fix: Use Long arithmetic for distances and SQL radius parameters; verify all three axes on memory, SQLite and optional DuckDB.

findings.issue: A hopper action that rearranged an unrelated identity could print a moved-zero route.
findings.fix: Only render routes with a source and a destination; retain the actual nonzero transfer.

documentation: Both public setup areas now state the optional WorldEdit adapter is Fabric only.
limits: Bounded bug review, not exhaustive proof of all mod compatibility. Native fixtures use synthetic players; NeoForge menu synchronization uses an in-memory channel. Actual pack item rollback diagnosis still needs its precise Player/Container detail. Real-client acceptance remains pending.
